title: Residue Tor between adjacent principal quotients
statement: For a principal adic datum d on a domain A generated by a nonzero π, set R_n to the finite function coefficient quotient and k_n to the first quotient unit restricted to R_n. Every H^i(L(R_(n+1)→R_n)_!(k_(n+1)[0])) is isomorphic to k_n for i≤0.

source.place: Order 1429, residue counterexample in (1); normalized tensor and periodic free resolutions, Stacks Tags 06YU and 0118.

proof.text: The completed principal quotient sequences remain short exact. Descend the completed scalar to an endomorphism t of the next unit using full quotient restriction. Epimorphism refinements and cancellation of the monic scalar prove exactness of the alternating pair t,t^(n+1). The lower quotient unit is the cokernel of the latter power. The normalized first quotient sequence shows that t kills the residue, hence all positive powers do. Apply the periodic Tor computation and compose the canonical restriction isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem principalAdjacentQuotient_tor
    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (π : A) (hI : d.ideal = Ideal.span {π})
    (hπ : π ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ 0) :
    let H := SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op 0)))
    let M := (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) 0 (Nat.zero_le _))).obj H
    let N := (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicQuotient T d n 0 (Nat.zero_le _))).obj H
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
      ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n))).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) ≅ N)
